docs.summary: Turns one imported asset into the form a given target wants.
docs.remarks: Desktop wants BCn where Android wants ASTC, and the universal imported form is neither. A processor declares what it produces and which assets it applies to; the resolver picks one by the target's stated preference and caches the result by content.

docs.summary: Stable, because it is part of the cache key.
Raise this when the processor's output changes, which invalidates only its own entries.
The texture or data format id this produces, matched against the target's preferences.
Whether this processor can handle the given asset.
